title: Actual completed module unit on a closed specialization neighbourhood
statement: Fix $\ell,E$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and qcqs schemes $X,Z$ [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-quasi-separated-morphism]. Let $i:Z\to X$ be a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion]. Let $V$ be an affine object of $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] such that every epimorphism of set sheaves valued in $\mathrm{Type}(\max(u,t+1))$ is surjective on $V$-sections. Suppose every point of $V$ specializes to a point of $V\times_X Z$. For every module $M$ over the completed integral coefficient sheaf [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients], the actual unit $M\to i_*i^*M$ of ordinaryAdjunction [def-fix-qcqs-completion-ordinary-models] is bijective on $V$-sections. The module and coefficient universe is $\max(u,t+1)$; scheme universe $t$ and coefficient-field universe $u$ are independent.

source.place: Tag 09AC, lemma-compute-i-star; with Modules on Sites Tags 03D2 and 03D3 for the module comparison and its unit equation.

proof.text: The closed-immersion case s=id of qcqsOrdinaryRestrictionExact makes the actual ordinaryCoefficientMap invertible. Reindex its ring adjunction and finite-projection-normalized direct ring map to the coefficient-sized small site. Restricting the adjunction preserves its unit and hence the invertible coefficient adjunct.

Use the independent-universe abelian specialization theorem for the left adjoint to actual abelian direct image. Restrict this adjunction to the coefficient-sized small sites; its unit is literally precomposition of the original unit, so its evaluation at the model of V is bijective.

Apply the proved independent-universe transfer theorem to these ring, abelian and module adjunctions. Its coefficient-adjunct instance is exactly the invertible ordinaryCoefficientMap, and its abelian hypothesis is the preceding specialization-unit computation. Its conclusion is the specified ordinaryAdjunction unit on V-sections.

lean.statement:
theorem ordinaryCompletedSpecializationUnit
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    {X Z : Scheme.{t}} [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    [CompactSpace Z] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Z]
    (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (V : X.ProEt) [IsAffine V.left]
    (hweak : ∀ (P Q : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) (Type (max u (t + 1)))) (φ : P ⟶ Q),
      Epi φ → Function.Surjective (φ.hom.app (op V)))
    (hspec : ∀ x : V.left, ∃ z : ↥(pullback V.hom i),
      Specializes x ((pullback.fst V.hom i) z))
    (M : Mod l E X none) :
    Function.Bijective (((ordinaryAdjunction l E i).unit.app M).val.app (op V))
